place_fields.summary: A garden-tomb ensemble associated with the Barid Shahi dynasty, with a charbagh layout and 16th-century funerary architecture.

planning_attributes.description: Barid Shahi garden-tomb complex on Palm Road in HussaniPura Colony, Aliyabad, Bidar.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The garden contains Barid Shahi tombs; Ali Barid Shah's tomb is associated with a charbagh garden and dates to the 16th century.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Barid Shahi Garden; Barid Shahi Park

place_fields.summary: A Hindu Shaivaite temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, associated with a naturally formed pond known as Papanasha Kund.

planning_attributes.description: Papnash Mahadev Temple in Aliyabad, Shiva Nagar, Bidar.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The temple is described as a Shiva temple with a Marakatha Shivalingam; devotees associate the nearby pond with Papanasha Kund.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: A road reaches the temple and cars can reportedly go up to the temple.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Papnash Mahadev Temple; Papanasha Shiva Temple
